CR01: Demand Forecasting and Headcount Planning

Demand Forecasting and Headcount Planning

Planning   /   Uses Fleet and Shifts   /   Supplies Recruitment

Forecast upcoming volume from observed activity and translate the workload into staffing requirements for each location × role.

Requirements

CR01-R01  Historical inputs. Use actual database volume and attendance when enough reliable history exists. Support a spreadsheet upload of three years of actual volumes as a fallback and match them to BambooHR attendance or uploaded Excel/CSV attendance by date, location and role pool. The volume template records date, location, activity, unit and actual quantity. Support several measures for a location and date, such as cases, stops and trips.

CR01-R02  Workload mapping. Admins can map each location × role to volume, fleet, tasks or any combination. Use task frequency and location-specific average task duration for every role. Convert distinct activities to workload hours and show each driver's contribution. Count shared work once.

CR01-R03  Daily values and overrides. Managers and admins can record actual delivered and committed volumes for the current day or past dates. Keep the original forecast, manager target, commitment and actual separate. For upcoming weeks, managers can view historical results and projections and enter targets. Targets take precedence over the forecast for operational scheduling calculations. Forecast and target variances are reported against actuals. Forecast inputs use actual observations.

CR01-R04  Confirmed rollover. Managers confirm the original date, activity, quantity and receiving date or dates. Recalculate the receiving location's workload and staffing by affected role and shift. Count carryover once when the manager's target already includes it. Preserve both days' actual delivery, link completion to the original rollover, and carry forward only any unfinished balance. Flag gaps on posted shifts for review.

CR01-R05  Staffing model. Divide workload hours by productive hours per full-time equivalent (FTE) for the period. Convert that capacity into rostered people using operating days, shifts, simultaneous coverage, availability and scheduling rules. Apply the greater of 5% or one person, rounded up, once to the DC's daily requirement. Use forecasts or manager targets to update workload-driven scheduling requirements.

CR01-R06  Outputs and scenarios. Store the annual headcount budget. Show recommended FTE and headcount by week, month and year, current staffing versus required FTE and budget, role health above/adequate/below, and shift or volume commitments at risk. Show the suggested base model and allow admins to save and compare changes to workforce criteria.

Acceptance Criteria

CR01-A01  Verify workload and coverage. Configure the same role differently at two DCs. Import several units for one day and trace each contribution. Confirm that 210 hours ÷ 37.5 hours gives 5.6 FTE, while 60 hours concentrated on Saturday needs eight people at 7.5 hours each before shrinkage.

CR01-A02  Verify rollover and alternatives. At 30 seconds per case, roll 300 cases to a date with fully allocated coverage and verify a 2.5-hour gap. Carry only the unfinished balance forward again. Compare a saved alternative against the base model and retain the original forecast after a target override.

Open Decisions and Verification

CR01  Annual headcount basis. Confirm whether the permanent recommendation is sized for peak demand or shown as a core team with separate peak or relief coverage. Agree on minimum usable historical coverage before automated forecasting.

Cross Feature Handoffs

CR01 / CR13  Fleet to Planning. Use operating availability at the location that has custody of the vehicle. Exclude assets unavailable for maintenance, repair or transit.

CR01 / CR02 / CR06  Planning outputs. Feed forecast- or target-based requirements to Shifts. Provide staffing recommendations and documented location-role duties to Recruitment.

CR02: Employee Availability and Temporary Shifts

Employee Availability and Temporary Shifts

Shifts   /   Uses BambooHR and the workforce scheduling file   /   Connects to CR04 and CR11

Default new employees to their location's working pattern and support approved, date-specific openings when a location is normally closed.

Requirements

CR02-R01  Employee defaults. For new BambooHR imports and manual additions, set Flexible for every configured shift on operating days and Unavailable on closed days. Later syncs preserve recorded employee preferences. Flag missing location or shift setup and exclude those employees from automatic scheduling until it is resolved.

CR02-R02  Calendar changes. Apply operating-day changes to future scheduling. Use the flexible default on newly opened days only where the employee has no saved preference. Flag affected published shifts for review when a day closes.

CR02-R03  Temporary opening request. A manager selects the location and closed date, records a reason, and supplies the start time, end time and staffing requirement for each proposed shift. Route the request to the Workforce Admin or Main Admin for approval. Open only the approved shifts for that date.

CR02-R04  Applications and selection. Notify the requesting manager's team once approved. Team members apply for the open shifts. The manager chooses employees up to the approved count per shift. Put confirmed assignments on their schedules.

CR02-R05  Taxi and payroll. Enable taxi requests only for confirmed shifts and eligible pickup directions under CR04. Hours worked on the temporary shift may be make-up time or overtime under CR11. Shift-opening approval and payroll-time approval are separate.

Acceptance Criteria

CR02-A01  Verify defaults and sync. Import and manually add employees at a six-day DC. Both are flexible Monday through Saturday and unavailable Sunday. Record a Saturday-specific preference and confirm that the next sync preserves it.

CR02-A02  Verify a temporary opening. Approve a Sunday stock-count shift for six people. Confirm that the team can apply, the manager can confirm up to six, and the recurring Sunday closure is preserved. Test taxi eligibility and payroll classification.

Open Decisions and Verification

CR02 / CR04  Late approval of a temporary shift. Confirm whether the Main Admin can set a separate taxi booking deadline when a closed-day shift is approved after the normal weekly cutoff. The pickup eligibility window still applies.

Cross Feature Handoffs

CR01 / CR02 / CR06  Planning outputs. Feed forecast- or target-based requirements to Shifts. Provide staffing recommendations and documented location-role duties to Recruitment.

CR02 / CR04 / CR05 / CR09 / CR11  Posted shifts. Supply eligible shifts to taxi bookings, taxi activity to provider reporting, matching shift assignments to recurring tasks, and scheduled intervals to payroll.

CR04: Taxi Bookings and Service Management

Taxi Bookings and Service Management

Shifts and Taxi   /   Supplies CR05   /   Uses posted shifts from CR02

Let eligible employees or their managers arrange transport and manage the provider handoff.

Requirements

CR04-R01  Eligibility and timing. Admins configure eligible locations and shift times or pickup windows. Show booking when that week's schedule is posted and a direction qualifies. The Main Admin sets the booking cutoff, defaulting to one day before the scheduled week starts. After cutoff, employees cannot create a new booking under the regular rule.

CR04-R02  Booking details. Employees can request incoming, outgoing or both; managers can book for their own team. Collect the ride's contact number and home address, and let the employee save preferred values for future bookings. Show separate incoming and outgoing icons on the shift.

CR04-R03  Bus list and dispatch. Any admin can generate the list with one row per ride, employee name, contact number, shift details, From and To. Incoming is home to DC; outgoing is DC to home. The Main Admin configures the provider, dispatch time and automatic sending. When enabled, generate and email at dispatch time. When disabled, provide the list and a manual email template. Schedule automatic dispatch at or after the applicable cutoff.

CR04-R04  Trades and cancellations. Finalized trades cancel bookings on the traded shifts. Employees can rebook for an eligible replacement shift while booking is open. Flag trade cancellations for admin follow-up if the list was already sent. Employees can cancel either pickup at any time. Email the admin and provider, remove that direction's icon, omit that ride from future lists, retain its cancellation history and preserve any other booked direction.

CR04-R05  Service issues. Employees can report a complaint against the affected shift. Include late or missed pickup, ride conditions, driver conduct and passenger conduct. Admins can see details and trends by period, date, location, shift, employee and category; export for the provider; and mark records Addressed, Escalated, Resolved or Withdrawn.

CR04-A01  Verify dates and routes. Test mixed eligible and ineligible shifts and a booking after cutoff. Book both directions and verify the two From/To routes and both icons. Test automatic dispatch and manual generation.

CR04-A02  Verify cancellation and issues. Cancel one ride after dispatch and verify that both recipients receive email and the other ride remains active. Trade a shift after dispatch and verify the follow-up flag. Submit, update and export a missed-pickup report.

Open Decisions and Verification

CR02 / CR04  Late approval of a temporary shift. Confirm whether the Main Admin can set a separate taxi booking deadline when a closed-day shift is approved after the normal weekly cutoff. The pickup eligibility window still applies.

CR06: Recruitment Requisitions and Employment Tracking

Recruitment Requisitions and Employment Tracking

Recruitment   /   Uses CR01 staffing recommendations and documented duties

Route hiring requests, prepare postings, and track recruitment and employment milestones.

Requirements

CR06-R01  Requisition decision. Managers request positions by location × role. Show the recruiter current staffing, required staffing, budget and the effect of the requested hires. Accept aligned requests into the tracker, or deny with a reason visible to the manager. An override requires the recruiter's reason and Main Admin approval before posting generation.

CR06-R02  Requisition dashboard. Show number of requests by location, including monthly, month-to-date and month-over-month views. Count by submission date, provide an overall total and allow status filtering across pending, approved and denied. A request for three positions is one requisition and three requested positions.

CR06-R03  Role profiles and posting. Keep a reusable job description, required qualifications and required experience for each role. The Recruiter Admin and Main Admin can edit. Managers can view and recommend changes. After approval, support automatic or manual posting generation using the role profile, approved requisition details and CR01 duties mapped to that location × role.

CR06-R04  KPIs and alerts. Generate daily, weekly and monthly reports overall, by location, job title and location × role. Measure open vacancies as open positions; RCT from approval to accepted offer; filled positions at accepted offer; fill rate as filled ÷ targeted positions; and vacancy percentage as open ÷ budgeted positions. Track actual start separately for workforce headcount. Recruiters and admins set goals and the recruiter receives overall and role-specific risk alerts.

CR06-R05  Probation and contracts. Track each separately, with original and current end dates and extension date, duration and reason. Create reminders and follow-ups for the manager and recruiter based on the current end date. Preserve earlier dates and extension history.

CR06-A01  Verify approvals and posting. Submit an override and confirm Main Admin approval is required. Generate postings for the same role in two DCs and verify the shared profile and location-specific duties. Check manager view and recommendation permissions.

CR06-A02  Verify counting and follow-up. Fill one position on a three-position request and verify one requisition, one filled and two open. Trigger a KPI risk alert. Extend probation and a contract and verify their separate histories and revised reminders.

CR07: Job Letter Requests and Generation

Job Letter Requests and Generation

Job Letters   /   Uses BambooHR employee and compensation details

Let employees request official letters using a controlled company template.

Requirements

CR07-R01  Template. The Main Admin provides and maintains the letterhead, body wording and footer, including logo, legal company name, head office address, phone and email. Configure where employee, recipient and issue details appear.

CR07-R02  Request and source fields. Employees can specify recipient name, organization and address, or use “To Whom It May Concern.” Acknowledge that Payroll is reviewing the request and completion is expected in 24–48 hours. Pull employee name, hire date, job title, location, department, employment type, basic pay, variable pay, motor vehicle allowance, gas card and acting allowance from BambooHR.

CR07-R03  Payroll review. The Payroll Admin may correct hire date, job title and compensation for the letter. Lock other fields, standard wording, letterhead, footer and layout during review.

CR07-R04  Delivery and manual path. On confirmation generate a dated letter and notify the employee. If the automated draft is denied, keep the request open and create a manual preparation task for Payroll. Payroll uploads the completed letter and Propa notifies the employee. Both paths give the employee a read-only preview and download of their own letter.

Acceptance Criteria

CR07-A01  Verify both paths. Test a named recipient and the generic salutation. Correct an allowed field, verify other fields are locked, and compare the generated letterhead/footer in preview and download. Deny a draft and verify task creation, manual upload and employee notification.

CR08: Projects Tasks and Meetings

Projects Tasks and Meetings

Projects and Tasks   /   Supplies project work to CR09   /   Uses Outlook or Google Calendar

Manage project work, dependencies, timeline, budget, discussions and meetings.

Requirements

CR08-R01  Project setup and access. Owners enter a description, expected start and end, initial budget and team. They can create tasks or request proposals from team members. Each project has a page with tasks, a discussion board and posts. Admins and team members can participate. Assigned watchers have read-only access to the page, tasks and posts.

CR08-R02  Task records and admission. Admins can create and assign tasks and post comments and updates. Team members can propose, assign and configure tasks. Owners approve inclusion in their project, including for tasks shared across projects. Track status, assignee, assignment date/time and reassignment history, start date, expected and actual end dates, effort, budget, comments and updates. Support subtasks and a checklist of requirements or resources.

CR08-R03  Dependencies and work queue. Support multiple prerequisites and successors, including dependencies across projects. Allow parallel work and prevent cycles. Show blocking and next-task indicators. Provide views by project and bucket. Notify the assignee on assignment, approaching due date, overdue status and prerequisite completion. Show Ready to Start when all prerequisites are satisfied.

CR08-R04  Completion and rollups. Require an evidence attachment for submitted completions and project owner approval before the task counts as complete or satisfies a dependency. Project progress is approved completed top-level tasks ÷ approved top-level tasks. The displayed end is the later of the initial date and latest approved task end; the budget is the greater of the initial amount and approved task budget sum.

CR08-R05  Views. Provide a project Kanban, Gantt and dashboard with completion, budget and timeline. Provide a portfolio dashboard with each project's completion, overall status and a combined Gantt.

CR08-R06  Meetings. Owners and team members can create single or recurring meetings, choose team invitees and link them to the business's Outlook or Google Calendar. Show upcoming meetings on the project page. Calendar invites provide reminders and joining when an online meeting link exists. Sync reschedules and cancellations to the original event.

Acceptance Criteria

CR08-A01  Verify project workflow. Share a proposed task across two projects, confirm independent admission approvals and preserve reassignment timestamps. Test two prerequisites, cycle prevention, evidence approval and updated progress, budget and timeline. Verify the watcher cannot post or edit.

CR08-A02  Verify calendar workflow. Create a one-off meeting and recurring series. Verify calendar visibility, reminders, online join and synchronization when an event is moved or canceled.

Cross Feature Handoffs

CR08 / CR09  Task reporting. Respect project owner evidence approvals when calculating project completion and daily productivity.

Shift Checklists Productivity and KPIs

Recalculate a four-week rolling average at day end using scored days within the latest 28 calendar days; show N/A when there is no scored work.

CR10: Coaching and Disciplinary Documentation

Coaching and Disciplinary Documentation

Coaching and Discipline   /   Uses employee and manager assignments

Document coaching or discipline, review cross-team referrals, and track delivery and follow-up.

Requirements

CR10-R01  Permissions and rules. Managers coach or issue discipline for their own team. Admins can do so across teams, including for managers. Show the applicable escalation level based on active disciplinary records in the selected category and offer the choice to proceed or record coaching.

Notify the employee and responsible manager at follow-up and closure.

CR11: Payroll Hours Timesheets and Overtime

Payroll Hours Timesheets and Overtime

Payroll Hours   /   Uses attendance, scheduled shifts and CR02 temporary shifts

Generate stored payroll hours and enforce extra-time approval and month-end corrections.

Requirements

CR11-R01  Daily payroll calculation. Preserve source punches and count clocked work within scheduled start and end. Early clock-in and late clock-out add no payable time without approval. Late arrival or early departure reduces worked time. Count an approved interval only once where it overlaps credited time.

CR11-R02  Extra-time approvals. Eligible employees or their managers for their own teams can submit requests. Route to the line manager then the Payroll Admin and add time after both approvals. Apply this also to additional time worked on approved closed-day shifts; opening a shift does not approve payroll hours.

CR11-R03  Thresholds and hours. The Main Admin sets eligible roles and a daily, weekly or monthly threshold basis. Use one active basis per role and 40 weekly hours by default. Count actual worked hours, including worked holidays, toward the threshold. Report approved leave and unworked holiday time separately. Classify approved extras up to the threshold as flagged make-up in regular hours, and classify the excess as flagged overtime.

CR11-R04  Records and download. Recalculate affected periods daily and after corrections or approvals. Apply the weekly rule across the whole week when it spans two months and allocate hours to the month worked. Store monthly timesheets for every scheduled employee with regular, overtime, holiday and time-off hours. Employees view their own weekly payroll hours; managers manually download team reports and admins download across all scheduled employees.

CR11-R05  Month-end removals. Admins can remove approved added time through the 10th calendar day after month-end. After that, require a reason and route the request to the Workforce Admin for approval. Keep the time while pending. After removal, recalculate affected weeks and months and retain original approval and removal history.

Acceptance Criteria

CR11-A01  Verify calculations. Test early and late punches, both approvals, and classification on a closed-day shift. For 36 counted hours plus six approved hours, expect four make-up and two overtime. Verify a week crossing month-end and role/team report access.

CR11-A02  Verify cutoff. Remove November time on December 10 and verify recalculation. On December 11 require Workforce Admin approval and leave the hours in place until approved.

CR12: Compensation Planning and BambooHR Updates

Compensation Planning and BambooHR Updates

Compensation Planning   /   Uses BambooHR history and approved file replacements

Model pay decisions and administer reviewed compensation changes through a separate record workflow.

CR12-R01  Scenario modelling. Payroll Admin and Main Admin can model salary increases, allowances and bonuses by role, department and tenure. Support macro assumptions such as inflation, sensitivity, group-level costs, saved named scenarios and side-by-side executive review.

CR12-R02  Budget targeting. Enter a target and choose which scenario assumptions may change. Find the best attainable result within those choices. Show each group adjustment, resulting cost and remaining difference. Saving a scenario stores the analysis; employee record changes follow the approval workflow.

CR12-R03  Bonus bases. Apply each employee's BambooHR bonus percentage to the chosen basis: time-weighted salary across effective periods, simple average of the applicable salary rates, first salary of the year, or last salary of the year.

Compare a June replacement with a June acting allowance omitted, preview the removal, and verify records outside June remain intact. Test failed or unsupported sync and confirm status is visible.

CR13: Fleet Operations, Maintenance, Loans and Driver Attendance

Fleet Operations and Maintenance

Fleet   /   Supplies operational availability to CR01 Planning

Manage vehicles and drivers, keep compliance and operating history, and track maintenance and fleet cost.

Requirements

CR13-R01  Vehicle register and access. Fleet Admins can add vehicles, define types, map a home location, upload a photo, amend records and retire vehicles. Track age and retain inspection, repair, loan, fuel, invoice and document history. Fleet Admin access is Fleet-only. Fleet Admins and coordinators can access Fleet logs and dashboards and generate daily, weekly and monthly reports. Scope coordinator access to assigned locations.

CR13-R02  Dashboard and documents. Show available, down and loaned vehicles, overdue downtime, issues by vehicle and type, fuel efficiency, invoices, vehicle age and retirement candidates. Selecting a vehicle shows its image, historical data and document type, expiry, status and uploaded copy. Track vehicle documents and driver permits/documents; alert Fleet Admins before and at expiry.

CR13-R03  Inspections and downtime. Coordinators complete daily, incoming, outgoing and safety inspections. Flag damage and defects, record out-for-repair time and flag vehicles out longer than the approved outage limit. Exclude vehicles out for repair or maintenance from operating availability.

CR13-R04  Maintenance. Alert the owning Fleet Coordinator and Fleet Admin when maintenance is due and remind both daily until the vehicle is confirmed Out for Maintenance. Show due, overdue and out statuses in the Maintenance dashboard and send daily reports. Fleet Admins receive the full scope; coordinators receive records for vehicles owned by their location.

CR13-R05  Incident rates and assignment. Log the internal or external driver assigned to a vehicle each day or trip. Link accidents and damage to the vehicle and the driver at the incident time; flag unmatched assignments. Show counts and separate accident and damage rates per driver, vehicle, type and fleet-wide in Maintenance. Use counts per 100 completed trips, show the denominator and show N/A where no trips exist.

CR13-R06  Fuel invoices and retirement. Record daily refuelling by vehicle with date, odometer and litres. Report km/L between full tanks including interim partial fills. Fleet Admins log invoices with provider, number, service period, amount, status and attachment, linked to vehicles/locations where applicable. Recommend retirement from age and history such as repeat repairs and extended downtime. Show reasons and let the Fleet Admin decide.

Acceptance Criteria

CR13-A01  Verify dashboard and maintenance. Select a vehicle, inspect its image, documents and history, and check vehicle-type and individual issue views. Trigger due maintenance and verify daily reminders and reports until confirmation. Verify the vehicle drops from availability, and that history survives retirement.

Fleet Loans and Driver Attendance

Fleet   /   Continuation of CR13

Track custody between DCs and record 3PL driver attendance independently of employee shifts.

Requirements

CR13-R07  Loan period and handover. Record the vehicle, home and borrowing locations, planned start and return dates, and release and receipt timestamps. Home coordinator confirms release and borrowing coordinator confirms receipt. Until both confirm, send daily reminders to the borrowing coordinator, borrowing location manager, home coordinator and Workforce Admin. Show the custody state and count the available vehicle at only one location; a vehicle in transit does not count as available.

CR13-R08  Extension and return. At expiry, the borrowing coordinator chooses End or requests an extension with a new return date. Allow early end. A Fleet Admin approves or declines extensions. Approval updates the date and alerts the home location Fleet Admin. A decline immediately notifies the borrowing coordinator, borrowing location manager, home coordinator and Workforce Admin to return the vehicle. The home coordinator verifies actual return before the loan closes or the vehicle is considered available at home, subject to fitness.

CR13-R09  Cancellation. Allow the home coordinator, borrowing coordinator or Fleet Admin to cancel a request. If released, retain the custody record until the home coordinator confirms the return.

CR13-R10  Driver register and DC movements. Keep internal driver records and maintain external drivers in a separate 3PL register. Record permits and supporting documents and date-stamped DC movements. Delivery Managers enter external driver attendance directly in Fleet, without creating shifts.

CR13-R11  Arrival configuration and attendance. Expected driver arrival defaults to 7:00 a.m. Managers can configure it for the teams or locations they manage; admins can configure across locations. Resolve team-at-location first, then location, then default. Apply changes from their effective date and retain the applicable time in earlier records. Delivery Managers mark Present, Late or Absent and may add a note including actual arrival time.

Acceptance Criteria

CR13-A02  Verify handover and return. Leave receipt outstanding and verify all four reminders continue until both confirmations. Approve one extension and decline another to check recipients. End a loan early and verify home availability resumes only after confirmed return and fitness.

CR13-A03  Verify driver records. Move a 3PL driver between DCs, record attendance against the receiving location and verify no shift is created. Set a team arrival of 7:30 a.m. and verify the attendance form uses it. Assign different drivers to two trips in the same vehicle and verify the incident links to the driver on the affected trip.

Cross Feature Handoffs

CR01 / CR13  Fleet to Planning. Use operating availability at the location that has custody of the vehicle. Exclude assets unavailable for maintenance, repair or transit.
